messages.content: I'm planning a trip to Lisbon from 12 to 19 March with my sister Ana.
Lovely! Do you have a budget in mind?
About 1800 euros in total, and we want to stay in Alfama.
Alfama is great for atmosphere. I'd suggest booking early since it is popular.
Our service is a FastAPI app on Postgres 18 and it times out on the /reports endpoint.
Is the query slow or is the app waiting for a connection?
The query. It does a sequential scan on the events table, about 40 million rows.
Add an index on events(account_id, created_at) and check the plan with EXPLAIN ANALYZE.

key_facts: sequential scan on the events table

messages.content: I'm vegetarian and allergic to peanuts. Can you suggest a week of dinners?
Sure. Do you cook for one or for a family?
Four people, 30 minutes max per meal, and nobody likes mushrooms.
Got it: vegetarian, peanut-free, mushroom-free, quick meals for four.
Help me write a cover letter for a data engineer role at Northwind Traders.
Happy to. What are your strongest relevant skills?
Six years of Spark and Airflow, and I cut our pipeline cost by 35 percent last year.
Great. I'll lead with the 35 percent cost reduction and the Spark and Airflow experience.

key_facts: six years of Spark and Airflow

messages.content: We decided to use Rust for the new parser instead of Go because of the zero-copy requirement.
Makes sense. What is the deadline?
Prototype by 4 April, production by end of June. Maria owns the project.
I'll note: Rust, prototype 4 April, production end of June, Maria owns it.
I am studying for the AWS Solutions Architect exam on 2 May.
Which areas worry you most?
VPC networking and IAM policies. I already know S3 and EC2 well.
Then spend most of the time on VPC peering, route tables and IAM policy evaluation.
My laptop is a ThinkPad X1 Carbon running Ubuntu 24.04 and the Wi-Fi drops every few minutes.
Which Wi-Fi chipset does it have?
Intel AX211. Power saving is on.
Try disabling Wi-Fi power saving in NetworkManager and update the firmware.
I'm organising a 40-person birthday party for my dad on 8 June in Pune.
What kind of venue are you thinking about?
A garden restaurant, budget 60000 rupees, and a vegetarian menu.
I'll look for garden restaurants with vegetarian set menus under 60000 rupees.
Explain how our team's code review process works: two approvals, CI must pass, no merges on Fridays.
Understood. Anything about hotfixes?
Hotfixes need one approval from the on-call engineer and can ship on Fridays.
Noted: hotfixes are the exception to the two-approval and Friday rules.

key_facts: hotfixes need one approval from the on-call engineer

messages.content: I want to learn Japanese for a trip in October. I know hiragana already.
How much time can you spend each day?
About 20 minutes on weekdays. I'd like to focus on speaking and travel phrases, not kanji.
Then drill katakana, numbers and polite travel phrases, with speaking practice.

key_facts: focus on speaking and travel phrases
